title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-14
source: source: aud cassette master taped by Jim Cooper; hitachi trq-222 deck nak bx-300 > benchmark adc1 > adobe audition cs6 > tlh flac; transferred & seeded by Rob Berger

ai_review.summary: Great vintage performance with standout Dark Star and Black Peter, captured in a good‑but‑vague recording
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the historic vibe of this early‑1970 show, highlighting a smoking Dark Star, powerful drumming, and classic numbers like Black Peter and Wake Up Little Suzie. The audio is described as an echo from the past – clear enough to enjoy but with no concrete technical details – while one reviewer notes the setlist doesn’t match other copies of the Feb‑14‑1970 show.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews praise the musical performance and overall vibe; a single 0‑star comment raises setlist concerns, leading to a solid but not flawless rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as an echo from the past – vintage feel, generally clear, no specific issues noted

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall praised, though one reviewer notes the setlist differs from other known copies of the Feb 14 1970 show

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mentioned cranking out ‘Wake Up Little Suzie’, implying strong guitar work
band_member_comments.Drums: Drummers are particularly impressive according to reviewers
